assembly_sequence: Install the brass inserts while their individual printed parts are accessible.
Populate front-top with its fixed valve rows and moving tee links, then slide it aft onto front-bottom.
Seat the funnel frame in front-top before the Y-seam closing motion.
Populate back-top on the bench, then slide it forward onto an empty back-bottom.
Move the complete back column forward over the tethered cold core into the front column at the Y telescope; cabinet-spanning plumbing follows the mechanical close.
With grip covers removed, insert the lower screw pair upward through the handholds; install the upper pair through the roof. Each head uses one flat washer.
Refit the grip covers after the lower screws are seated.

access.lower_screw_entry: Place the loose washer first: lift it tilted through the exposed handhold, flatten it above the ceiling, move it onto the screw axis and hold it against the pocket floor. Insert the separate screw upward. A flat washer already on the screw does not clear the inner wall.
access.handling_qualification: Nominal geometry is clear; two-handed washer holding and the exposed printed handhold finish are not physically qualified.

frame_support: The front receiver pair carries the frame; the rear frame body clears the upper screw blocks. Nominal capture against six 2 mm translations does not establish a load rating or resistance to tilting under load.

packing_motion_review.method: A moving block is conservatively enclosed by its bounding prism extended along the complete positive-Y withdrawal/inverse insertion interval. Screw passages and head pockets only remove material from this checked stock.

path: Hold a loose washer at 35 degrees about Y, centered 0.2 mm outboard of the screw axis. Lift it from below the handhold.

Raise the washer to Z36.25..37.25 and hold it against the bearing floor. Insert the separate M5 screw upward through the washer and printed passages.
